decisions.reason: Definite possessive 'your daughter' in turn 1 directly presupposes B has a daughter.

decisions.claim: B's daughter will be back soon
decisions.reason: Complete relational claim from turn 1 includes both existence and temporal return; distinct from c1 which only asserts existence.
'your vacation' presupposes B is on vacation; 'supposed to be' adds mild hedge but does not negate the presupposition.

decisions.claim: B is staying at or visiting A's home
decisions.reason: Multiple turns (1, 3) show A offering B use of TV room, inviting relaxation at A's home, presupposing B is physically present at A's residence.

decisions.claim: B suggested an idea that A endorsed
decisions.reason: 'that's a good idea' in turn 7 presupposes B made a suggestion that A endorsed; the endorsement is explicit in A's speech.

decisions.claim: B expressed concern that something was broken
decisions.reason: 'I don't think it's broken' presupposes B raised a concern about something being broken; A is responding to that concern.

decisions.claim: B is staying at A's home
decisions.reason: Same claim as c4 (B staying at A's home) derived from overlapping evidence (turns 3 and 13); c4 is more complete with additional evidence from turn 1.

decisions.claim: B offered or suggested to help with the cooking
decisions.reason: Turn 9 'I'll just get out the casserole dish' is A volunteering to do tasks; there is no evidence B offered or suggested help. The 'fine' could be a response to A's own proposal or a neutral acknowledgment.
decisions.counterexample: A may simply be stating their own plan without any prior offer from B.
